svg.title: What to check before editing documents in AI conversations with Office in Copilot
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
What to check before editing documents in AI
conversations with Office in Copilot
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-20
What changes: documents open beside
the conversation
The announcement gives this example: If you ask,
“Turn this research memo into an executive
action summary,” a Word document opens beside…
What administrators should check
first: permissions, security labels…
The announcement explains that files are saved
to OneDrive, retain sharing permissions and
version history, and inherit the organization’s…
Model selection should be evaluated
alongside cost and results
According to the announcement, users can choose
a model suited to the task or select the Auto
option to let the system choose automatically.
Rules to establish before adoption
If documents for the same project are scattered
between Office apps and the Copilot app, it can
be difficult to find the latest version.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
